cases.scope: Fresh constructor, one descriptor and two heap sections. Legacy empty/partial failures characterize the memory constructor; skip-zero and descriptor-first controls reject proposed repairs. Models retained helper ownership and caller rollback, not a change to adjust_msections' valid partial-growth API. Primitive allocations are atomic and destructors succeed. Excludes nonfresh expansion, address sorting, linked-list pointer integrity, custom allocators, concurrent users, weak memory and native admission.
